name: Dr. Ru Shan Shy
headline: ZSA Educator · Clinical Practice · Neuroscience-Informed Teaching
bio: Dr. Ru Shan Shy is a direct disciple of Professor Ming Qing Zhu and an international educator in Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture. Her training includes medicine at China Medical University, graduate study at National Taiwan University, and advanced doctoral-level neuroscience training at the Institute of Neuroscience, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, Taiwan. Her work integrates classical Chinese medicine, clinical observation and neuroscience-informed reasoning.

name: Dr. Sheng Chun Chang
headline: ZSA Educator · Clinical Practice · Pharmacy, Neuroscience & Chinese Medicine
bio: Dr. Sheng Chun Chang is a direct disciple of Professor Ming Qing Zhu and an international educator in Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture. His multidisciplinary background spans Pharmacy, Neuroscience and Chinese Medicine. His teaching connects classical ZSA principles with biomedical, pharmacological and neurophysiological perspectives.
